title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Master cassette -> metal cassette x 2 -> CD-R (Sony K717ES -> Marantz CDR500) -> Audacity -> FLAC; Pitch adjusted - 1% to match patch source.
source: FOB audience recording, taper and equipment unknown - may have been Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear FOB recording captures a high‑energy Ventura show highlighted by a thundering “Loser” and a powerful “Ramble On Rose.”
ai_review.review: The front‑of‑house tape delivers impressive upfront sound, great presence and clear bass, with only an isolated cut in “Ramble On Rose” that has been patched in later versions. Musically the show is praised as a top‑10 favorite, driven by Jerry’s soaring solo on “Loser,” Phil’s booming bass, and an overall tight, high‑energy performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong positive comments about both the musical performance and the sound quality; only minor technical issues noted, yielding a rating in the good‑to‑excellent range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Up‑front clarity, strong presence and balanced bass; one cut in “Ramble On Rose” that was later patched. Overall crisp and listenable FOB mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑sequenced set with strong transitions; the performance feels cohesive and energetic throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Solo on “Loser” described as thundering, haunting and a favorite among listeners.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work on “Loser” called “bass bombs,” adding power to the performance.
